text:
Demons' Night Fever - Official Pre-Order Trailer
Get a deep dive into the grid-based tactical combat gameplay of Demons' Night Fever in this latest trailer for the upcoming speedrun-focused simulation RPG. Demons' Night Fever will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, and Steam on October 22, 2026.

The combat of Demons' Night Fever shatters conventions with its dark comedy "Peon Exploitation System," forcing players to mercilessly sacrifice their own allies (alongside killing enemies) in order to win. This is a story of another Earth, different from the one we live on. Giga Super Death, the most wicked Devil of all, was just one step away from killing God… when suddenly, he was transformed into a helpless baby. Anticipating such a crisis, Giga Super Death had been working through the night to develop the "DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER" resurrection program – and finally, it was time to activate it. Was it a prank of fate, or inevitable destiny? The one ensnared in this suspicious ritual was Killshiro Katanaka, a gloomy young man who despises the world. Due to their aligned interests, a bizarre pact was formed. This is the story of pure EVIL, starring the Devil himself and his newfound disciple, Killshiro.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
The Relic: First Guardian Review
The Relic: First Guardian review by Jarrett Green on PC.

The true dark fantasy of The Relic: First Guardian is all of the potential it squanders. It is the bones of something that could have grown to be a notable action game, especially in its energetic combat. But everything about this experience, including its combat, is marred in some way by its own shambolic state. The janky subtitles and sometimes straight-up terrible visual quality could be tolerated, but The Relic is fundamentally broken in too many inexcusable ways. It’s a gem that's barely cut, let alone polished.

#TheRelicFirstGuardian #TheRelic #Soulslike
